restricted_paths: live camera hardware validation or capture
acceptance_criteria: Add a served HMI screen at /hmi.
The screen connects to /ws/inspection and renders the latest inspection.snapshot payload.
The screen shows service context, connection state, phase, decision, reason codes, product/spec, measurements, frame/source/timestamp, and observations state.
Current draft product specs and synthetic calibration display fail-closed BLOCKED evidence.
The design is operator-focused, compact, scan-friendly, and not a marketing/landing page.
Existing health and WebSocket endpoints remain compatible.
No QC feedback form, live camera, raw media, model weights, production deploy, secrets, or production authority are introduced.
Existing Flange QC v2 unit/contract tests, product CI, and full repository tests pass.
test_commands: Browser smoke: open /hmi locally and verify the screen renders the blocked replay payload.
rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-011 PR to remove the HMI screen, ASGI static serving change, tests, and evidence artifacts. This task does not alter production data, migrations, secrets, or deploy configuration.
